user.title: Music Light Sync
user.description: Connects to Music Assistant's Sendspin server as a light player. After setup, approve the new player in Music Assistant, then group it with the speaker you want the lights to follow.

data.name: Name (shown as a player in Music Assistant)
data.lights: ZHA color lights (a light group helper is expanded)

data_description.lights: Every light must be a ZHA light. Order matters: the first bulb gets the bass band in Max reactive mode.
data_description.host: The machine running Music Assistant. For the add-on, the Home Assistant host's IP address works.
data_description.port: Music Assistant's Sendspin server listens on 8927.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Sendspin server at that host and port.
error.not_zha: Every selected light (and every member of a selected group) must be a ZHA light.

data.zha_group_id: ZHA group for unison color changes
data.end_delay: Restore the lights after this much silence

data_description.zha_group_id: Optional. A ZHA group containing exactly these bulbs. One multicast frame then changes every bulb at once, but multicast floods the whole mesh, so it is rate limited separately.
data_description.rate_max: Upper limit of unicast Zigbee frames per second for the show. 20 trades a little Zigbee responsiveness for livelier lights; the governor still backs off automatically if the mesh gets congested.
data_description.group_min_interval: Multicast frames use the coordinator's small broadcast table. Keep this at 2 s or more.
data_description.pause_entities: Automations, switches (for example adaptive lighting) or input booleans that are turned off during a show and back on afterwards, if they were on.
data_description.end_delay: Pausing, skipping and short gaps between tracks do not restore the lights unless the silence lasts longer than this.
data_description.fallback_player: Optional. When this player is playing but the light player is not grouped with it (for example the Node on its native hi-res path), the bulbs run the ambient palette from its album art.

error.group_members: That ZHA group must contain exactly the configured bulbs, no more and no fewer. Extra members would be left in show colors.
error.group_missing: That ZHA group no longer exists.

state.awaiting_approval: Waiting for approval in Music Assistant
